headline: Reagan warns high tariffs cause *trade wars*
quote: High tariffs inevitably lead to retaliation by foreign countries and the triggering of fierce trade wars.
title: President Ronald Reagan: 1987 warning on tariffs and trade wars
caption: President Ronald Reagan discussed the dangers of protectionism during a 1987 radio address. He argued that tariffs lead directly to retaliatory trade wars.
comment: Do you think tariffs are ever an effective long-term economic strategy?
